heading: The VGLI deadlines in 72 seconds
name: Leaving the military: your life insurance deadlines
description: The VA life insurance dates that count from the day you leave the military: 120 days for SGLI, 240 days to apply for VGLI without proof of good health, and 1 year and 120 days to apply for VGLI. Honorbrook is an independent agency, not affiliated with the VA.
transcript: Leaving the military? Here are your life insurance deadlines. 3 dates to know, counted from the day you leave. Honorbrook is an independent agency, not affiliated with the VA. VA facts here come from va.gov, checked November 2026. Your SGLI coverage continues for 120 days after you leave. Apply for VGLI within 240 days, with no need to prove good health. After that, you can still apply, with evidence of good health. The deadline to apply for VGLI is 1 year and 120 days after you leave. Spouse coverage under FSGLI has a 120-day date too. Within 120 days of your separation, your spouse can convert it to a permanent individual policy, such as whole life. Mark day 120 and day 240. An independent agent can show private options next to VGLI, so you can compare. Want to talk it through? Schedule a time at honorbrook-insurance.com or call (301) 615-8289.
